title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 137 (White-Moscow Forest Service Road)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
White-Moscow Forest Service Road
137 That portion of M.U. 4-24 within 50 m of either side of the White-Moscow Forest Service Road from the junction with Whiteswan Forest Service Road to the junction with the Moscow-Home Basin Campground road. [en. B.C. Reg. 130/2016, App. 1, s. 4.]
